feeds.title: CapitalBop Blog
feeds.description: CapitalBop, Inc. is a nonprofit organization dedicated to preserving, promoting and presenting jazz in Washington, D.C. We build audiences in order to build a community around this music, because it's important to the city's historic identity, but also ever-changing and contemporary. CapitalBop.com is designed to help everyone from newcomers to jazz die-hards find live music that will fit their preferences.

feeds.title: DC Heavy Metal
feeds.description: DC Heavy Metal blog specializes in heavy metal music and how it relates to Washington DC and the surrounding area. Featuring info on upcoming metal concerts in Washington DC, Baltimore, and Virginia, as well as info on local bands, area concert venues, reviews of live gigs, and lots of giveaways.

feeds.title: NPR » Music
feeds.description: NPR is an independent, nonprofit media organization that was founded on a mission to create a more informed public. Every day, NPR connects with millions of Americans to explore the news, ideas, and what it means to be human. In the following segment, NPR features Music news, streams, live concerts, and more.

feeds.title: Parklife DC
feeds.description: We blog about arts and entertainment around the city, and we specifically look at the following happenings - Live Reviews, Preview, Interviews, Around Town, and Stars and Bars. We are DC's biggest blog for concert reviews.

feeds.title: Soundazed
feeds.description: Hear it here first -- stream the latest Soundazed Premieres and be sure to keep up with the most important music news from around the world. We bring you all the latest news, album reviews, interviews, and more.

feeds.title: Blisspop
feeds.description: Dance music website covering house, techno, disco, chill out, electronic, and all the sounds between. Operating since 2000.

feeds.title: Capitol Sound DC
feeds.description: Capitol Sound DC is a female-run music blog that focuses on showcasing local talent, highlighting touring acts, and promoting shows that create inclusive live music experiences for the DMV community.

feeds.title: Words Beats & Life Inc.
feeds.description: Words Beats & Life offers classes, workshops and events in DJ'ing, Graffiti, MC'ing and Breaking in Washington DC, and the greater DMV area. We also offer these workshops on college campuses nationally and with community partners globally. We host radio shows on WPFW 89.3FM and publish a global journal of hip-hop culture.

feeds.description: Fuzzy Logic is a DC-ish music blog run by one music-obsessed girl who writes about the music she loves and nothing else.
